figures.Fig25.12: A tropical thorn forest with representative flora and fauna. Original figure archived as c12-bio-ch25-fig-thorn-forest (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture). The book's picture of the ecosystem with its flora and fauna is replaced by a simple labelled landscape schematic with a fact card (owner rule: plants and animals as simple labelled sketches).

findings: The book lists rattlesnakes among the fauna; rattlesnakes are found only in the Americas. The lesson attributes the list to the book, flagged.

Owner rule (2026-10-21): the English lesson carries only the book's content. Our explanations, notes on the print, self-check questions with their answers, the recap, 3D models and figures the book does not print are in the Roman Urdu lesson only; where the book's own Quick Check or Brain Teaser questions are given, the English lesson lists them without answers.
